items: Design and evolve the GraphQL schemas that platform services and frontend applications use to access data.
Build resilient Node.js APIs for service-to-service communication in a distributed architecture.
Improve resolver performance and query efficiency, reducing over-fetching and client response times.
Apply clean architecture and modular design to keep a growing TypeScript codebase maintainable.
Work with platform engineers and product and frontend teams to ship secure features to production.

Melhoro o desempenho dos resolvers e a eficiência das consultas, reduzindo o over-fetching e o tempo de resposta para os clientes.
Aplico arquitetura limpa e design modular para manter sustentável uma base de código TypeScript em crescimento.
